name: product_sign
description: Give positive/negative sign of a product of signed nonzero integers; matched control copies an operand.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 a=random.choice([-1,1])*random.randrange(1,30);b=random.choice([-1,1])*random.randrange(1,30)
 items.append({'prompt':f'Give only the sign of the product.
(2)*(3): positive
(-2)*(3): negative
(-2)*(-3): positive
({a})*({b}):','answer':' '+('positive' if a*b>0 else 'negative')})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Copy only the first factor.
(2)*(3): 2
(-2)*(3): -2
(-2)*(-3): -2
({a})*({b}):','answer':' '+str(a)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
